<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
# Python script to compute missingness per indicator and select indicators based on missing rate
import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_missing_file = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_selected_file = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input CSV
input_df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Compute missing values per indicator
missing_counts = input_df['indicator'].apply(lambda x: input_df[input_df['indicator'] == x]['missing'].count())

missing_rates = (missing_counts / len(input_df))

# Create the missingness report
missing_report_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': input_df['indicator'],
    'missing_count': missing_counts,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates,
    'kept': (missing_rates <= 0.30).astype(str)
})

# Write the missingness report
missing_report_df.to_csv(output_missing_file, index=False, dtype=str)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_df = input_df[missing_rates <= 0.30].copy()

# Select columns: city_id, city_name, year and indicator columns
selected_df = selected_df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', selected_df.columns[1:]]]

# Write the selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv(output_selected_file, index=False, dtype=str)
print("Output files created successfully.")
print(f"Missingness report has {len(missing_report_df)} rows")
print(f"Selected matrix has {len(selected_df)} rows")
</solution_file>
